tool_contract.instructions: Inspect and test the learner-readable repository. Submit exactly one complete unified diff when the available evidence determines a correct change. The neuronal <stop> choice is terminal and neutral: it never crosses the external executor and never produces an action receipt. Evaluator checks return only a conclusion unless a reviewer supplies new public text.
tool_contract.learner_readable_files: the exact task mount allowlist, including public tests as read-only evidence
tool_contract.patch_hashing: the runner computes sha256 from the submitted UTF-8 diff
tool_contract.patch_paths: repository-relative canonical POSIX paths from the writable source allowlist; tests, configuration, README, additions, deletions, renames, mode changes, binary patches, absolute paths, and traversal are rejected
tool_contract.writable_files: existing Python files under the repository package directory
